records.name: Hakata Ramen + Bar
records.quote: This spot specialises in ramen but also offers some Japanese sides too. They offer a vegan version of all of their ramen options which is amazing! It's also a cute spot for a casual lunch

records.name: Su Vegan Buffet
records.quote: This no-frills vegan Chinese buffet is cheap-and-cheeful food rather than a fancy restaurant experience but it's great value and the range of options is impressive

records.name: Chickenish
records.address: Saint Monday, 4 Warburton Rd, London E8 3RR, UK
records.quote: Chickenish occupies the kitchen inside this acclaimed brewery so you can enjoy a bite and a beer at the same time. You can choose from vegan chicken burgers, wings or bites and they have a big outdoor seating area and spacious interior too

records.name: Mondo Sando
records.quote: Fully loaded sandwiches with a few vegan options. Located inside a pub so good for grabbing a bite to eat over catch up drinks at the weekend. Check their latest menu as the selection does change
records.fave: Vegan festive sandwich with fennel & herb Symplicity mince, chestnut stuffing, miso mayo, fried sprouts, boozy prunes, crispy onions & rocket

records.name: Plants of Roselyn
records.fave: Pad Thai, Green curry, Aubergine Gra pow, Sweetcorn cakes, Mieng khum, A mushroom shakes the world, Yellow curry, Sweet chilli tofu
records.quote: This fully vegan spot is a tropical-inspired Thai restaurant with a focus on traditional, wholesome Thai home-style cooking and street food with a modern approach. A good choice for a catch up with a friend

records.name: Mukbap
records.quote: One of my fave spots, this fully vegan Korean hole-in-the-wall restaurant is run by a mother and son duo. They serve plant-based versions of classic dishes such as japchae but only have a handful of tables so sometimes there's a queue but it's worth the wait - one of my favourite places for a relaxed meal

records.name: Purezza
records.quote: London's only fully vegan pizzeria with puffy sourdough crusts, creative toppings and comfort-food sides and desserts. This is a good choice for an easy dinner with friends where everyone will be satisfied

records.name: Jam Delish
records.fave: "Fish" tacos, Brown stew oyster mushroom fried dumpling, Callaloo and "saltfish" fritters, Jerk "chicken" skewers, Fried "chicken" with garlic mash, Chocolate panna cotta
records.quote: This fully vegan Caribbean restaurant is one of my favourite spots and a great place to bring non-vegans because there's lots of creativity, textures and flavours. Chef Nathan trained under Jamie Oliver and loves to experiment and change the menu regularly. This is a nice spot for a date night with cocktails too

records.name: Coven of Wiches
records.quote: Coven of Wiches is a dive bar and vegan sandwich shop in Brixton Village. They offer a selection of sandwiches and sides and they don't mess around when it comes to portion sizes. Bib advised.

records.name: Tofu Vegan
records.fave: Wontons in a spicy sauce, Sliced "fish" in sizzling oil, Gungbao "chicken", Mapo tofu, Twice cooked fish bao, Sweet potato noodles in a spicy sesame sauce, Cloud ear mushrooms, Dim Sum
records.quote: One of my absolute faves in the whole city. This fully vegan spot has a cult following and is popular with vegans and non-vegans alike. They create vegan versions of traditional (and less traditional) Chinese dishes. I highly recommend booking ahead as this place gets incrediby busy! The perfect spot to go with a group so you can try a bit of everything

records.name: Mallow
records.quote: Located right in the middle of Borough Market in a spacious and beautiful building, this fully vegan, sustainable spot delivers seasonal food with flavours from around the world. Good for small groups, date nights or a catch up with a friend

records.name: Tendril Kitchen
records.quote: One of my fave London restaurants, this spot is all about showcasing the beauty and versatility of vegetables. Their seasonal menu is always almost entirely vegan apart from one dish. The restaurant is modern and cosy and it's a lovely choice for a date night
records.fave: Grilled beetroot, hoisin, parfait, Butterbean & leek emulsion, Tiramisu

records.name: Club Mexicana
records.address: Boxhall City, 1-27, The Arcade, London EC2M 7PN, UK
records.fave: Birria tacos, BBQ short rib taco, Cheeseburger taco, BAJA tofish
records.quote: One of London's best and oldest vegan spots, this fully vegan Mexican street food restaurant serves tacos, loaded nachos and burritos

records.name: Gauthier
records.fave: Ras el hanout bun, Berlingot carbonara, Tempeh hash & Kind Juniper game
records.quote: One of London's only fully vegan dining spots with a seasonal tasting menu and wine pairings. Located in the heart of Soho, the restaurant has more of a traditional, formal feel to it. This is a good choice for an anniversary, birthday or date night

records.name: Roti King
records.quote: A cult-favourite Malaysian street food spot with affordable prices and punchy flavours. Not tonnes of vegan options but the limited offering is executed well. Great for casual dinners

records.name: Pied à Terre
records.fave: Beetroot meringue, Celeriac "scallop", Collard greens, Basamati rice dolma, Rhubarb & sorbet, Chocolate mousse
records.quote: A fine dining spot with a vegan tasting menu. They had some creative dishes when I visited and I found the service friendly and welcoming without feeling too stuffy. The restaurant is beautiful too - one to book for a special occasion

records.name: Mealtime Malatang
records.quote: Build your own Chinese hotpot by choosing ingredients from their fridge and picking a base. They have lots of vegan options including various forms of tofu, lots of vegetables and noodles too. The labelling could be better so to be safem ask which broths and sauces are vegan before putting your meal together

records.name: Studio Gauthier
records.quote: This fully plant-based spot takes a seasonal approach and has a more relaxed feel than it's sister fine-dining restaurant. A good choice for a nice meal that isn't too extravagant. They have a beautiful dining room and a nice outdoor area
records.address: BFI Building, 21 Stephen St, London W1T 1LN, UK

records.name: Merkamo Ethiopian Stall
records.quote: Fully vegan, Ethiopian market stall in Old Spitalfields Market. This hearty food is built around lentils, beans, vegetables and spices, and is really good value for money. Good choice for a filling but healthy lunch. Seating is available in the market but it can get busy

records.name: The After School Cookie Club
records.address: Unit 33 Boxpark Shoreditch, Unit 8, 10 Bethnal Grn Rd, London E1 6GY, UK
records.quote: This plant-based spot is all about cookies from cookie dough to cookie ice cream and is the perfect on-the-go spot when you fancy a sweet hit.

records.name: Merkamo Ethiopian Restaurant
records.quote: Fully vegan, cosy Ethiopian dine-in restaurant just off Brick Lane. This hearty food is built around lentils, beans, vegetables and spices, and is really good value for money. Good choice for a filling but healthy lunch or dinner

records.name: Take a Bite and Smile
records.fave: Lemon curd cruffin, Chocolate cannolo, Custard tart, Pistachio swirl, Cinnamon Bun
records.quote: This unbelievable plant-based patisserie specialises in Italian (and non-Italian) baked goods from cruffins to cannoli. A lovely spot for a quick coffee and bake with some indoor and outdoor seating. They also cater to gluten-free and soy-free diets

records.name: Black Cat
records.address: 76A Clarence Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 8HB, UK
records.quote: One of London's oldest vegan spots, this proudly vegan cafe serves all day breakfast and comfort food. The casual setting makes it an option for stopping by on your own as well as meeting a friend for lunch.

records.name: The Dusty Knuckle
records.fave: Crispy breaded aubergine in a curry sauce with pickled carrot & daikon and mayo on focaccia
records.quote: This popular East London bakery specialises in incredible bread and sandwiches. They don't have many vegan options but the one they have on the menu is usually very good. This is a casual spot for a quick lunch

records.name: De Beauvoir Deli
records.fave: Vegan festive sandwich with mushroom pate, sprout slaw, pickled red cabbage & deep fried parsnips
records.quote: A neighbourhood deli where their sandwiches draw queues. I mainly visit for their festive sandwich which is always delicious but they do have vegan options and vegan products all year round

records.name: Indian Veg
records.quote: This no-frills vegetarian buffet has lots of vegan options including curries, dal and rice. You won't get much better value in London than this spot. You can sit in but the restaurant is very casual. Good for an affordable lunch

records.name: Itto
records.address: 61 Stroud Green Rd, Finsbury Park, London N4 3EG, UK
records.fave: Singapore noodles, Vegetable gyoza, Szechuan tofu, Aubergine
records.quote: A cosy pan-Asian restaurant with a decent amount of vegan options including noodles, gyoza, tofu and and vegetable dishes. A good spot for sharing with friends or a casual date night

records.name: Trinco at Oru Space
records.fave: Spicy muttonless roll, Biryani, Aubergine curry
records.quote: Sri Lankan cooking with tonnes of flavour and a build-your-own-thali concept which gives you the freedom to choose your combo. The portions were generous and the venue is beautiful - perfect for a date night or evening catch up with a friend

records.name: Kaffa Coffee
records.quote: This fully vegan Ethiopian spot is essentially a food truck with outdoor seating in the heart of Dalston. I used to go there a lot when I lived nearby - it's very casual and the food is flavoursome, fast and affordable

records.name: House of Momo - Boleyn Road
records.fave: Vegetable thali, Fried vegetable chilli momos
records.quote: A popular, casual Nepalese spot serving generously filled momos and big thalis. It's a small, relaxed intimate space good for solo dining or dinner with a friend

records.name: Daddy Bao
records.quote: A Taiwanese spot serving fluffy bao and small plates to share. Not a huge vegan menu but a few dishes done well. A casual spot for a chilled lunch or dinner

records.name: Aya & Suki
records.fave: Crispy cauliflower with BBQ kimchi and stem ginger, Sesame miso aubergine with mango tahini, Candied walnuts and pickled chilli
records.quote: Eastern Mediterranean influences run through the menu of this cosy small plates spot on Broadway Market. Whether you're here with a group or catching up with a friend, the best approach here is to share so you can try a bit of everything!

records.name: Mali Vegan
records.quote: An incredible fully vegan Thai restaurant with a menu built around family recipes with plenty of options. A casual, spacious restaurant with both indoor and outdoor dining. One of my fave spots for a flavour-packed meal

records.name: Papo’s Bagels
records.quote: This spot serves one thing and one thing only - bagels (and it does it really well). They offer a delicious vegan schmear! This is a good stop for breakfast or lunch on the go

records.name: Plum Valley
records.fave: Kung po mock chicken, Cheung fun
records.quote: This Chinese restaurant in the heart of Chinatown spans across several floors. There's surprisingly an impressive range of vegan choices including dim sum and mock meat dishes. This is a good option for group dining that caters to both vegans and non-vegans

records.name: Toba
records.quote: Indonesian cooking with a few plant-based dishes. This is a modern, trendy restaurant that's good for sharing and trying flavours you wouldn't normally try
records.address: 1a St James's Mkt, London SW1Y 4AH, UK

records.name: Mc & Sons
records.quote: An old-school Irish pub with Thai food. They usually have one or two vegan options on offer. There's a garden, live music and a great vibe

records.name: Amrutha
records.fave: Dhal with tamarind chutney, Thai green curry, Mushroom, aubergine & broccoli pakora
records.quote: Fresh, flavoursome vegetable-focused cooking with a warm, generous, community-minded feel. A good choice when you want a comforting meal in a cosy setting with friendly staff.

records.name: Arapina
records.address: 8 Little Thames Walk, London SE8 3FB, UK
records.quote: A vegetarian bakery with lots of plant-based options where everything is also gluten free. From croissants to cinnamon scrolls, these are so good, you won't believe they're vegan

records.name: Scully St James's
records.address: 4 St James's Market, London SW1Y 4AH, UK
records.fave: Arepa with aubergine, sambal, cedro lemon & coconut labneh
records.quote: Creative cooking drawing on several cuisines with a vegan tasting menu that I loved when I visited. This is a good choice for a special occasion where you want to experience some unique flavour combos and new flavours

records.name: Apricity
records.fave: Courgette flower, XO mushrooms, Strawberries with cashew cream, "goldencomb" and raspberry granita
records.quote: Previously awarded a Green Michelin star for sustainability, this spot is all about seasonal British produce and a low-waste approach from the cooking through to the recycled decor. Not a vegan spot but very vegan-friendly

records.name: Naïfs
records.fave: BBQ red pepper kebab, Lentil pate, Beetroot & smoked almond, Lentil fritters & Choc mousse
records.quote: A cosy, candlelit restaurant in Peckham championing vegetables. They offer seasonal dishes in a tasting menu format

records.name: Plates London
records.fave: Laminated sourdough bread, Barbecued maitake mushroom
records.quote: Probably the best restaurant in London, this is the city's only michelin-starred plant-based spot and it is absolutely mind-blowing in every way. The decor is chic yet cosy, the wine pairings are perfect and the food oozes creativity and flavour. It's clear as every dish arrives how much talent and skill has gone into creating it. Definitely one for a special occasion!

records.name: Facing Heaven
records.quote: This fully vegan spot shines a light on dishes from different regional parts of China as well as the more well-known dishes with dishes like cold XO noodles and Hong Kong French toast on the menu. Expect loud music, a disco toilet and edgy retro decor.

records.name: Utter Waffle
records.quote: Waffles are the main event at this cafe with sweet and savoury options and some vegan choices. A good spot for brunch when you want something different!

records.name: Crisp Pizza
records.quote: One of London's most well-known pizza spots, these guys offer thin, crispy pizza with a flavoursome San Marzano tomato sauce. When I visited they didn't offer vegan cheese so I took my own (lol) but since then, they started using the amazing Julienne Bruno vegan cheeses which I'm keen to go back and try.

records.name: Third Culture Deli
records.fave: The Caprese, The Kimchi, Peanut butter chocolate "eclair"
records.quote: This daytime deli offers sandwiches, coffee, pastries and cake as well as a fridge with vegan cheeses and other products to take away. They also host supper clubs! This is a good stop for lunch or a coffee break when you fancy something a bit different

records.name: Tao Tao Ju
records.quote: This popular Chinatown spot offers a decent array of vegan options including dumplings, noodles and tofu dishes. A good option for a pre-theatre meal or a group get together which caters to both vegans and non-vegans

records.name: Beaten by a Whisker
records.address: Unit 3, 5a Old Brewery Way, London E17 7FJ, UK
records.quote: One of the best bakeries in London, fully vegan Beaten By A Whisker often sells out of its popular items by midday so make sure you get in there early to enjoy their bakes! This is a cute spot for a coffee meet up with a friend or for a laptop working day.

records.name: British Patagonia
records.fave: Raspberry stuffed pastry, Pain au Chocolat
records.quote: This artisinal bakery was founded by a chef with michelin-kitchen experience. It has a big vegan offering and serves up anything from a croissant to a roast with all the trimmings

records.name: Tofu Vegan
records.fave: Sliced "fish" in sizzling oil, Gungbao "chicken", Mapo tofu, Wontons in a spicy sauce, Twice cooked fish bao, Sweet potato noodles in a spicy sesame sauce
records.quote: One of my absolute faves in the whole city. This fully vegan spot has a cult following and is popular with vegans and non-vegans alike. They create vegan versions of traditional (and less traditional) Chinese dishes. I highly recommend booking ahead as this place gets incrediby busy! The perfect spot to go with a group so you can try a bit of everything

records.name: Tofu Vegan
records.address: 28 N End Rd, London NW11 7PT, UK
records.fave: Sliced "fish" in sizzling oil, Gungbao "chicken", Mapo tofu, Wontons in a spicy sauce, Twice cooked fish bao, Sweet potato noodles in a spicy sesame sauce
records.quote: One of my absolute faves in the whole city. This fully vegan spot has a cult following and is popular with vegans and non-vegans alike. They create vegan versions of traditional (and less traditional) Chinese dishes. I highly recommend booking ahead as this place gets incrediby busy! The perfect spot to go with a group so you can try a bit of everything

records.name: SUSHISAMBA
records.fave: Mushroom tobanyaki with yuzu sauce & garlic chips
records.quote: A fusion of Japanese, Brazilian and Peruvian influences come together in this pricey, special occasion spot. I wouldn't have minded a few more vegan options on the menu but there were enough to get by. Check the menu before visiting as it does change

records.name: Rasa Sayang
records.quote: Malaysian and Singaporean food with vegan options packed with flavour. This is a good option for a casual meal where you can share a few plates

records.name: Detroit Pizza
records.quote: This spot serves thick, Detroit-style pizza baked in steel pains with light, airy dough and a crisp, cheesy edge. They don't have tonnes of vegan options but they always have one option on the menu

records.name: KIBOU
records.quote: This Japanese restaurant has a good range of vegan dishes from sushi to katsu. The restaurant is beautifully designed and it would be a nice place for dinner with friends or a date night

records.name: Namaste at OMNOM
records.address: Islington Square, 116N Upper St, London N1 1QP
records.quote: This vegetarian Indian restaurant offers a wide array of vegan options on a playful menu that fuses creative dishes with more traditional onces. The venue itself is stunning, surrounded by windows which let in lots of light and make the venue feel grand but not stuffy. A good choice when you want an Indian meal that offers vegetable focused dishes as well as mock meat options

records.name: Vegan Planet
records.fave: Spicy wontons, "Prawn" toast, "Pork" dumplings, Char siew
records.quote: A fully vegan Chinese restaurant with an extensive menu and a focus on dim sum. This is a great spot to go with friends so you can try a bit of everything

records.name: Turtle Bay
records.summary: This chain offers Caribbean food and cocktails in a casual setting with a few vegan options alongside their wider menu. A good one for an affordable group meal

records.name: Bánh Mì Hội-An
records.quote: This hole in the wall spot specailises in Vietnamese sandwiches. This is a good choice for a quick, takeaway lunch.

records.name: Pabellón
records.quote: This spot serves Venezuelan street food and is a good takeaway lunch option when you fancy something hearty but healthy. You can add sweet potato fries if you're hungry! Not tonnes of vegan options but one or two

records.name: LD’s Kitchen
records.address: 40-42 Chalk Farm Rd, Chalk Farm, London NW1 8BG, UK
records.quote: Amazing fully vegan soul food eatery serving plant-based barbecue food and incredible, hearty Sunday roasts with all the trimmings. Heavy metal and dive-bar culture combined with gourmet plant-based cooking, everything here is made from scratch which makes it even more impressive

records.name: SlowBurn
records.fave: Sprouts, Tacos, Fritters & Purple sprouting broccoli
records.quote: This casual restaurant is one you won't forget as it's set in a working denim factory! Modern European, vegetable-focused small plates with creative combinations. The menu lends itself to sharing, whether with one person or a group

records.name: Dauns
records.quote: A casual, fully vegan cafe with Scandinavian influences. They offer a range of sit-down meals like Swedish meatballs as well as pastries and coffee. They also have a deli with vegan products you can buy. It's a cosy space, goof for solo diners who can sit at the window and people-watch or a casual catch up with a friends

records.name: The Nelson’s Pub
records.address: 32 Horatio St, Bethnal Green, London E2 7SB, UK
records.quote: A buzzy pub right near Columbia Road that serves vegan roasts. This is a good spot for a Sunday afternoon at the pub with friends after a stroll around the flower market

records.name: Mother Mash
records.address: 26 Ganton St, Carnaby, London W1F 7QZ, UK
records.quote: British comfort food at its finest, this spot serves up dishes such as mash, pies and sausages. The decor also takes inspiration from London’s traditional pie-and-mash shops with marble tables and friendly service. Not tonnes of vegan options but a few

records.name: Pivot Bar & Bistro
records.quote: A British bistro with creative plant-based dishes and a bottomless Sunday roast which is one of my favourites in the city. The restaurant is beautiful and looks out over Covent Garden - one to book for a more special occasion

records.name: The Spread Eagle
records.address: 224 Homerton High St, London E9 6AS, UK
records.fave: Hen of the woods buffalo burger, Beet wellington roast
records.quote: London's only vegan pub, this is a great spot for weekend drinks and food. Their roasts are very popular and they also serve drinks and cocktails (of course). This is ideal for a group catch up with friends

records.name: The Cheese Cellar
records.quote: A fully vegan wine and cheese cellar located inside Purezza. Formerly known as La Fauxmagerie, this spot offers wine pairings in their cosy, candlelit cellar and also has a deli upstairs if you'd like to take some home. A perfect spot for a date night!

records.name: Golden Union
records.quote: This well-known fish and chip shop serves vegan versions of the classics including "fish", battered sausage and pies. They do have lots of seating if you don't want to takeaway

records.name: Imad’s Syrian Kitchen
records.address: 2.5, Top Floor, Kingly Ct, Carnaby St, Carnaby, London W1B 5PW, UK
records.quote: A Syrian restaurant with a vegan-friendly menu, this spacious restaurant is located on the top floor of buzzy Kingly Court. Bring a friend and share a spread

records.name: Kolamba
records.address: 21 Kingly St, Carnaby, London W1B 5QA, UK
records.quote: A modern Sri Lankan restaurant serving flavoursome food and a good selection of plant-based dishes. Sri Lankan-owned, the menu highlights traditional family recipes with influences from across the country. Beautiful, intimate restaurant with a good buzz

records.name: Korean BBQ House
records.quote: A casual Korean restaurant with a good selection of vegan options, good for dinner with friends who want a mix of vegan and non-vegan options

records.name: Pockets
records.quote: One of my fave spots, this takeaway spot specialises in one thing- falafel pitta. It's the best falafel pitta I've ever eaten and seeminly a lot of other peoples too as it has a bit of a cult following and can get quite busy. It's worth queuing for and is the perfect on-the-go lunch option

records.name: Fatt Pundit
records.quote: These guys specialise in Indo-Chinese cooking with a decent selection of vegan small plates, all executed very well. A great place for a date night where you can share all the dishes

records.name: Sen Viet Chay
records.fave: Bun hue - spicy noodle soup with "ham" & mixed veg, Sweet & sour ribs
records.quote: This incredible yet underrated vegan Vietnamese restaurant has a huge range of dishes to choose from and it's a perfect spot for taking non-vegans to show them how great vegan food can be

records.name: Angelina
records.quote: A tasting menu where Italian meets Japanese. An intimate dining room and open kitchen make a dinner here feel like an occasion. When I visited, they had a special vegan menu, now you need to call to inform them of any dietary requirements before visiting or when booking.

records.name: The Bull & Gate
records.address: 389 Kentish Town Rd, London NW5 2TJ, UK
records.quote: This pub offers a vegan roast with trimmings which is fairly unusual. I only visited once and thought it was nice - not the best I've had but a good option if you're in the area and need a spot that caters to both vegans and non-vegans

records.name: En Root
records.address: 5, Ascot Parade, Clapham Park Rd, London SW4 7EY, UK
records.quote: This fully vegan spot serves flavoursome Indian-inspired food that's good for the body and the soul. The restaurant is casual, the prices are affordable and the vibe is relaxed

records.name: JUMA
records.address: Borough Market Kitchen, Jubilee, Winchester Walk, London SE1 9AG
records.quote: Iraqi street food in Borough Market with some plant-based options. There is some outdoor (covered) seating but the market gets quite busy so bear that in mind

records.name: Horn OK Please
records.address: Unit 55, Borough Market Kitchen, Jubilee Pl, Winchester Walk, London SE1 9AG, UK
records.quote: Vegetarian Indian street food in the middle of Borough Market. A good lunch option. Some outdoor but covered seating available but the market gets very busy so you may have to stand at busy times

records.name: 123V
records.quote: Plant-based sushi and small plates are the focus here with inventive dishes including spicy tofu "crab" rolls and 3D printed flank "steak" nigiri. You can either dine in the chic but laid back dining room or the spacious and leafy courtyard.

records.name: Floozie Cookies
records.address: 15, The Market Building, Lower Ground, London WC2E 8RE, UK
records.quote: These guys do one thing and one thing only - cookies. Soft, gooey cookies with a variety of fillings. It used to be fully vegan but now it's veggie with vegan options so just check the allergens before ordering. Good stop for a sweet treat, either to sit in or to go

records.name: Buddha Taste
records.address: 8 Royal Parade, Blackheath, London SE3 0TL, UK
records.fave: Katsu curry, Hot glazed coated tofu with a fiery sauce
records.quote: This Vietnamese cafe is a fully plant-based spot with a big menu to choose from. It's a nice casual restaurant for a laid back lunch or dinner

records.name: My Neighbours the Dumplings
records.address: 178-180 Victoria Park Rd, London E9 7HD, UK
records.quote: This cute, cosy, lantern-lit restaurant specialises in dumplings but also offers some side dishes too. Order some tofu and veg dishes for the table to make a proper meal of it. Indoor as well as outdoor seating available

records.name: Rosa’s Thai London Fields
records.summary: This Thai chain offers a decent amount of vegan options and is a useful spot for a relaxed meal with friends at an affordable price

records.name: Spinach & Agushi
records.fave: Vegan mixed box with spinach & agushi, butterbean coconut curry, jollof rice and fried plantain
records.quote: This Ghanaian street food spot doesn't serve many vegan dishes but the ones they do serve, they do really well. A nice, filling lunchtime option with flavour

records.name: Kutir
records.quote: Upscale Indian fine-dining in a beautoful restaurant. Housed in a converted Georgian townhouse, this intimate, cosy but refined restaurant is a beautiful spot for a special occaison. I absolutely loved my meal here! Make sure you let them know when booking that you're vegan

records.name: Kanishka
records.fave: Grilled aubergine filled with smoked auberginem tamarind & coconut sauce, Samosa chaat, Saag aloo
records.quote: This Indian restaurant is best suited to a more formal, special dinner. It's a little pricier so it's good for a date night. They had a good amount of vegan options when I visited but I'd advise checking when booking to ensure they still do

records.name: Galvin La Chapelle
records.quote: This is a Michelin-starred French and Mediterranean fine-dining restaurant that offers a special vegan tasting menu. I'd recommend letting them know you're vegan before booking to ensure the vegan menu is available at that time
records.fave: Veloute of ironbark pumpkin & crispy sage, Risotto of wild mushrooms, soft herbs & truffle

records.name: Bubala
records.fave: Fried aubergine, zhoug & date syrup, Shiitake & oyster mushroom skewers, tamari, coriander seed & maple
records.quote: Vegetables are the star of the show at this veggie Middle Eastern spot which has a menu designed for sharing

records.name: The Egerton House Hotel
records.quote: This hotel hosts an afternoon tea with a vegan version available including sandwiches, sweets and scones. It was a while ago I visited so just double check the menu before booking. A good spot for a birthday treat or a Saturday catch up with a friend.

records.name: Cutter & Squidge
records.quote: This is an all-natural bakery using fruits, vegetables and flavouring with reduced fat and sugar, but the products still feel indulgent. It's been a while since I visited but they still offer some vegan options. Good spot for a catch up with a friend.

records.name: Xi’an Biang Biang Noodles
records.fave: Biang biang noodles in special sauce
records.quote: Owned by the same people as Tofu Vegan, this non-vegan restaurant does offer a few vegan options. The hand-pulled noodles are the main pull (pardon the pun) here. This is a good choice for a fiery, filling meal but if you're choosing between this and Tofu Vegan, choose TV

records.name: Itadaki Zen
records.quote: A fully vegan Japanese restaurant sevring sushi and Japanese dishes such as kitsune udon. The restaurant is cute and nicely decorated and it's a good spot for a low-key dinner

records.name: Lime Orange
records.quote: A casual Korean restaurant with a few vegan options. This spot is right near Victoria station so good for a relaxed meal before or after the theatre or when you're arriving into this train station
records.fave: Vegetable mandu, Cucumber & pear kimchi marinated with chilli & garlic

records.name: Kahani
records.quote: Indian cooking in a more elevated setting suited to an occasion or formal dinner. They had a fair few vegan options when I visited but I'd let them know when booking to ensure they still do
records.fave: Truffle & radish paratha with black garlic spinach, Marinated tandoori broccoli jaggery with nigella seeds & wheat crisps

records.name: Clapton Country Club
records.quote: This is one of my favourite spots for a Sunday roast, in terms of both food and atmosphere. Located in a beautiful building with a mezzanine, fairy nights and often a live band, they offer a couple of vegan roast options and they do them really well.
records.fave: Wild mushroom & truffle wellington Sunday roast

records.name: Arros QD
records.fave: Vegetable paella with traditional aioli, Kale citrus salad
records.quote: Wood-fired rice and Valencian paella cooked with a large open-fire stove. The cooking and setting make this a more occasion-led meal

records.name: Baluchi
records.quote: Baluchi fuses Indian cooking with modern flair in a hotel restaurant setting, but not just any hotel - the grand hall is a stunning room that makes the meal feel like an occasion. siteContent.aboutTitle: Who is The Little London Vegan?
siteContent.aboutBody:
Hello! I’m Clare, a little vegan from London (does what it says on the tin, really). 

Once upon a time, I was an avid meat-eater but after watching some hard-hitting documentaries, I connected the dots, made the switch and became vegan.

Since 2017, I’ve ventured around London (and the world) finding the best vegan food on offer, so I know a thing or two about London's vegan food scene and the restaurants that are genuinely worth visiting.

I don't want to tell you where you *can* eat, I want to tell you where you *should* eat.

This page brings together all of the knowledge and personal experience I've gained over the last decade and every place has been tried and tested by me. I've done the hard work for you (if you can call professionally eating hard work) and you'll find all of my favourite spots from street food stalls to Michelin-starred restaurants. 

The aim is to make your life easier, whether you're new to London or you've lived here forever. 

Enjoy! 
Clare - TLLV x

The new branch is a welcome addition to the heart of central London making vegan food more accessible for tourists and Londoners alike.

Opening on Wednesday 11th November, this dining concept transforms the terrarium boutique into an immersive plant-based sanctuary where you can dine on plant-forward food whilst surrounded by greenery. 

The Bistro concept is led by chef Stephen Cherry, who has two decades of fine-dining and event experience. It offers a hearty all-day menu featuring lasagne, butter chickpea curry, croissant bread & butter pudding and creamy tiramisù.

From 5pm, the kitchen shifts to an evening sharing menu featuring dishes such as sticky hoisin mushroom tacos, onion bhaji sliders crisp patatas bravas. 

Enjoy!

Food and drink at The Bistro in King’s Cross The menu is inspired by its verdant surroundings, reflecting the Botanical Boys’ signature terrariums in its Hummus Pot, presented as a miniature edible garden of crisp seasonal vegetables planted in creamy hummus. The Bistro’s exclusive South African vegan wines from partner vineyard Blaauwklippen also feature on the menu, in Red Wine Arancini of sun-dried tomato and red onion, and White Wine Arancini of spring onion, peas and fresh herbs. news.headline: La Vie Brings Vegan Bacon to Terry’s Cafe
news.summary:
The French are coming for the Full English. 

For three days only, vegan bacon brand La Vie is teaming up with Terry’s Cafe, a London institution since 1982, famous for its very much non-vegan breakfasts.

On 29th October, Terry’s full British menu will be 100% plant-based from a vegan version of their Billingsgate roll made with oyster mushrooms and La Vie bacon and French toast topped with bacon & ice cream. 

Between 12.30pm and 4.30pm, 100 free two course meals are up for grabs - a main, dessert and drink. 

Seats are free but limited, so you’ll need to book a spot. If you can’t make it down on that day, don’t worry because the menu will stick around for two days after that too. Enjoy!
